en: Black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard showing interiors of the Thomas‑Müntzer‑Haus in Oschatz. The four photographs depict: a dance bar with round tables and cushioned chairs; a restaurant with neatly arranged square tables and simple wooden chairs; a large hall with many table rows and a balcony gallery; and another view of a bar area with a long counter, bar stools and small café tables. The central band carries the name 'Thomas‑Müntzer‑Haus Oschatz', and small captions label the scenes as Tanzbar, Restaurant, Großer Saal, and Tanzbar.
